text: XTB is a Polish brokerage listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since 2016; its largest shareholder, with 27.78%, is XX ZW Investment Group S.A., a Luxembourg entity directly controlled by XTB founder Jakub Zabłocki. The rest of the shares are free float.

source.note: The page's table lists XX ZW Investment Group S.A. at 27.78% with footnote: "XX ZW Investment Group S.A., based in Luxembourg, is an entity directly controlled by XTB founder –Mr. Jakub Zabłocki, who holds shares representing 81.97%..." XTB's own About page (https://www.xtb.com/en/about-us) states: "Since 2016, we have been proudly listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange."
